page.overview:
Who is Cosmos?

Cosmos is a tall, fat woman wearing a tube top and a Kuja hat.

She is cheerful and is usually seen smiling.

As a member of the Kuja Pirates, it can be implied that she is very strong as only the strongest warriors are allowed on the Kuja ship.

Cosmos was on the Kuja Ship in the Calm Belt near Amazon Lily when Vice Admiral Momonga was requesting a meeting with Boa Hancock. After Hancock turned Momonga's crew into stone, the Kuja Pirates returned to Amazon Lily.
